rationale: Record a scheduling change that crosses this family only through its broad core/view/** and test/** selectors. WidgetBridge::load_script stops flushing requestAnimationFrame callbacks once the host has driven service_frame_callbacks(), leaving them for the next frame tick, and VisualizationBridge gains an opt-in latest_window backlog policy for poll(). No renderer, backend, asset, importer, DesignIR, capture path, codegen output, fixture, threshold or Vellum-owned source changes. Registered as watch-only so the family's coverage stays honest about a change that crossed its selectors. No authority moves and no Vellum artifact changes.
